title: Im Tired
intro: Im Tired makes the reward for retirement almost absurdly small: an afternoon alone with milk tea. The narrow road then explains why even that modest freedom feels remote—everyone is competing for room, and effort does not return appreciation. Effie's guest verse offers movement inside the chaos rather than escape from it, mixing smallness, style, defiance and affection. Jackzebra's refrain returns afterwards. The collaboration lets these responses coexist without deciding that dancing has cured exhaustion or that withdrawal is the only possible answer.
reading: Unclaimed time versus compulsory effort; guest's activity and lead's retreat coexist without a neat cure.

revisions.t40-phrase-retirement: Retiring from working life is an enormous change to request in order to obtain one quiet afternoon. That disproportion measures how completely time feels claimed by other demands. The fantasy does not require luxury or applause, only a drink enjoyed without obligation. Heard after 'All In', where home is forbidden until success, it offers a different criterion for enough: time that belongs to the person living it.
revisions.t40-n1: The narrow road makes competition a problem of available space, not merely individual determination. People can put in more effort and still injure one another trying to fit through. The preceding question about lost children asks where someone without a route should go at all. This gives the retirement wish a social setting: exhaustion is produced by the conditions of moving forward, not simply an absence of ambition.
revisions.t40-n2: The paired refusals concern spending both mental attention and bodily effort. The idiom then names the failed return: the work does not even earn appreciation. Repetition turns withdrawal into a sustained refusal of that bargain. The speaker is not saying that he has never cared or worked; the complaint depends on having spent both and finding that the demand can continue without recognition.
revisions.editorial-40-dance-chaos: Effie asks for dancing while the disorder continues. Her verse has already made the self tiny like plankton, so the invitation is not issued from a secure position above the trouble. It proposes action without waiting for repair. Jackzebra's subsequent return to retirement preserves a different response to the same pressure. The feature adds a perspective; it does not function as a motivational correction to his fatigue.
